verdict.rationale: Convex documents scaffolding a project from the CLI (`npm create convex@latest`) and an agent-oriented setup flow. Schema and functions live in code and the CLI pushes them to a dev or local deployment. Authorization rules are written as code, and auth comes from the Convex Auth library or OIDC providers, so an agent can author all three as files. However, the documented push path is a filesystem watcher (`convex dev`), and nothing shows a non-interactive, scriptable one-shot provisioning or deploy flow. Missing for 10: a documented headless/non-interactive CLI mode (e.g. deploy keys or a one-shot push/deploy suitable for scripts), CLI-driven auth provider configuration, and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven end-to-end setup.
